items.title: 1.3.1.3 Doosre tareeqe: Scrum aur Lean (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Scrum and Lean with Figs. 1.4 and 1.5 (PDF 13-15).

blocks.text: Scrum ek agile framework hai jo complex (pecheeda) software projects ko chalane aur mukammal karne ke liye bohat istemal hota hai. Yeh iterative (chhote chakkaron mein dohra kar) progress, mil jul kar kaam (collaboration) aur lachak (flexibility) ko barhata hai, is liye un badalte mahol ke liye bohat munasib hai jahan requirements aksar badalti hain. Yeh framework roles, events aur artifacts par bana hai jo project management ko munazzam (structured) bhi rakhte hain aur badalne ke qabil (adaptable) bhi.
Scrum ke aham hisse (Key Components of Scrum)

items: Roles (kirdar): Scrum ke main roles Product Owner, Scrum Master aur Development Team hain. Product Owner product backlog (kaamon ki list) banata hai aur dekhta hai ke team sab se zyada tarjeeh (priority) wale kaam par kaam kare. Scrum Master process ko aasan banata hai, rukawatein hatata hai aur dekhta hai ke team Scrum ke tareeqon par chale. Development Team, jis mein mukhtalif maharat wale log hote hain (cross-functional), product ke naye hisse (increments) bana kar deti hai.

Events: Scrum mein baqaida progress aur jaiza (review) ke liye events hote hain: Sprints (muqarrar waqt ke iterations), Sprint Planning, Daily Standups (rozana chhoti meeting), Sprint Reviews aur Sprint Retrospectives (sprint ke baad apne kaam ke tareeqe par ghaur).

Artifacts: Scrum ke aham artifacts yeh hain: Product Backlog (features aur requirements ki tarjeeh wali list), Sprint Backlog (ek sprint mein poore hone wale kaamon ki list) aur Increment (maujooda sprint ke nateeje mein bana hua chalta product).

blocks.text: Scrum kin ke liye munasib hai: Scrum khaas taur par un software projects ke liye munasib hai jin mein baar baar updates chahiye hon aur requirements badalti rehti hon, jaise:

items: Mobile Applications: mobile app banane mein aksar musalsal feedback aur tez iterations chahiye hote hain ta ke users ki zarooratein poori hon aur app muqable mein rahe. Scrum ka iterative tareeqa user feedback aur market ki tabdeeli par jaldi tabdeeli karne deta hai.

Web Development: un web applications ke liye jinhein baqaidagi se naye features aur behtari chahiye. Scrum aisa development process deta hai jo nayi requirements aur user feedback ke mutabiq jaldi dhal jata hai.

blocks.text: Scrum kin ke liye munasib nahi: jin projects ki requirements pehle se saaf hon aur tabdeeli ka imkaan kam ho, un ke liye Scrum shayad behtareen na ho, jaise:

items: Embedded Systems: embedded systems (machines ke andar lage software) mein aksar hardware ke saath jorna aur sakht qawaneen (regulations) hote hain; un ke liye Scrum ke iterative tareeqe ki bajaye purana, linear (seedha) tareeqa behtar ho sakta hai.

Safety-Critical Software: medical software ya aerospace (jahaz aur khala) systems jaise projects, jahan mukammal documentation aur bohat zyada jaanch (validation) zaroori hai, Scrum ke lachakdar aur iterative tareeqe se achi tarah mel nahi khate.

blocks.text: Figure 1.4 Scrum ke process ka bahao (flow) dikhati hai: is ke aham hisse aur Scrum framework mein un ka aapas mein talluq.

blocks.alt: SCRUM LIFECYCLE ke unwan ke neeche: Product Backlog (kaamon ka lamba dabba) se Sprint Planning aur phir Sprint Backlog. Scrum Team ke gird ek chakkar, jis ke oopar Daily Scrum hai, Sprint Backlog ki taraf surkh teer aur Increment (khula dabba) ki taraf jamni teer bhejta hai; Increment se Sprint Review. Sprint Review se lakeerein Sprint Retrospective, phir Sprint Planning, aur neeche se Product Backlog tak wapas jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.4: Scrum Lifecycle (kitab ki Figure 1.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ko baen se parhein: Product Backlog (tarjeeh wali features ki fehrist) se Sprint Planning mein kaam chuna jata hai aur Sprint Backlog banta hai. Scrum Team sprint ke dauran kaam karti hai aur roz Daily Scrum (chhoti meeting) karti hai. Sprint ka nateeja Increment hai, yani chalne wala product. Sprint Review mein us ka jaiza hota hai; phir Sprint Retrospective mein team apne kaam ke tareeqe par ghaur karti hai aur agli Sprint Planning hoti hai. Neeche wali lakeer Review se Product Backlog tak wapas jati hai, kyunke raaye (feedback) se backlog badalta hai.

Lean Software Development software banane ka iterative tareeqa hai jo efficiency, waste (bekaar kaam) khatam karne aur high-quality products jaldi dene par zor deta hai. Yeh Lean manufacturing (karkhanon mein bachat wale tareeqe) ke usoolon se nikla hai. Lean Software Development kaam ke bahao (flow of work) ko behtar kar ke aur ghair zaroori kaam kam kar ke customer ko value (faida) dene par tawajjo deta hai.
Lean Software Development ke aham usool (Key Principles)

items: Eliminate Waste: woh kaam pehchan kar hata dein jo customer ke liye koi value nahi barhate.
Amplify Learning: musalsal behtari aur seekhne ka mahol banayein.
Decide as Late as Possible: faisle jitni der se ho sake, taaza tareen maloomat ki bunyad par karein, ta ke ghair yaqeeni kam ho.
Deliver as Fast as Possible: chhote chhote, qadam ba qadam (incremental) features jaldi dene ko tarjeeh dein.
Empower the Team: teams ko faisle karne aur masle hal karne ka ikhtiyar aur zimmedari dein.
Build Integrity In: development ke poore process mein quality qaim rakhein.
See the Whole: kaam ke poore bahao ko behtar karne ke liye poore system aur us ke mahol ko dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein usool number 4 adhoora chhapa hai: "incremental feat". Poora jumla yeh hai: chhote, incremental features jaldi dene ko tarjeeh dein (Prioritize rapid delivery of small, incremental features).

blocks.alt: Lean Development likhe gol kinaron wale dabbe se patli lakeerein saat rangeen dairon tak jati hain jin mein chhote nishan hain: Eliminate Waste, Amplify Learning, Decide as Late as Possible, Deliver as Fast as Possible, Empower the Team, Build Integrity In aur Optimize the whole.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.5: Lean Software Development Model (kitab ki Figure 1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Saat daire Lean ke wohi saat usool (principles) hain jo oopar list mein hain, usi tarteeb mein. Figure mein saatwen usool ka naam 'Optimize the whole' hai, jab ke list mein 'See the Whole' likha hai; dono ka matlab ek hi hai: poore system ko dekh kar kaam ke bahao (flow) ko behtar banana.

Lean kin ke liye munasib hai: Lean Software Development khaas taur par un projects ke liye munasib hai jinhein tez delivery aur baar baar iterations chahiye, jaise startup software, mobile applications aur web-based services. Misal: nayi mobile app banane wala startup user feedback par jaldi jaldi tabdeeliyan kar ke aur faida dene wale updates de kar Lean ke usoolon se faida uthata hai.

Lean kin ke liye munasib nahi: jin projects mein shuru mein bohat zyada planning chahiye aur jo bohat complex hon ya sakht qawaneen ke paband hon, jaise bare enterprise systems, embedded systems ya safety-critical applications, un ke liye Lean shayad behtareen na ho. Misal: aviation control system (hawai jahazon ko control karne wala system) ka software banane mein sakht documentation, bohat zyada testing aur qawaneen ki paabandi (regulatory compliance) chahiye, jo Lean ke iterative tareeqe se achi tarah mel nahi khati.

blocks.prompt: Scrum mein kaun sa role rukawatein hatata hai aur Scrum practices ko aasan banata hai? (Exercise MCQ 5) Scrum framework ke aham hisse bataein aur har ek project management mein kaise madad karta hai. (Short Question 4)
blocks.explanation: Scrum Master, option (b). Roles har shakhs ki zimmedari saaf karte hain (Product Owner tarjeeh tay karta hai, Scrum Master process chalata hai, Development Team product banati hai). Events baqaida planning, rozana rabta, review aur behtari ka silsila dete hain. Artifacts kaam ko nazar aane wala banate hain: kya chahiye (Product Backlog), is sprint mein kya hai (Sprint Backlog) aur kya ban gaya (Increment).

blocks.prompt: Ek project mein bohat zyada documentation chahiye aur sakht regulatory requirements hain. Scrum is ke liye kyun munasib nahi, aur is ki jagah kaun si methodology behtar hai? (Long Question 3)
blocks.explanation: Kitab kehti hai ke Scrum un projects ke liye munasib nahi jin ki requirements pehle se saaf hon aur jahan mukammal documentation aur bohat zyada validation zaroori ho, kyun ke Scrum lachakdar aur iterative hai. Aise project ke liye zyada traditional, linear tareeqa, yani Waterfall Model, behtar hai: har phase ki mukammal documentation aur manzoori ke baad hi agli phase shuru hoti hai.

items: Scrum: agile framework; roles (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Development Team), events (sprints, planning, daily standups, review, retrospective), artifacts (product backlog, sprint backlog, increment).
Scrum mobile aur web apps ke liye munasib; embedded aur safety-critical software ke liye nahi.
Lean: waste khatam karna, saat usool (Eliminate Waste se See the Whole tak); startups aur mobile apps ke liye munasib, sakht qawaneen wale bare systems ke liye nahi.
